lq.ANSWER: Right utilisation means using physical facilities and natural resources according to real need, not according to greed or blind consumption. Water insecurity shows that even when natural water availability exists, mismanagement, deforestation, pollution, over-extraction and wrong storage systems create scarcity. Food insecurity shows that the problem is not always lack of production, but wrong distribution, wastage and wrong priorities. Population also becomes a problem when it is not guided by right understanding and responsibility. These issues show that physical resources must be understood in relation to human needs, harmony in nature and future generations. Therefore, right utilisation includes conservation, reduction of waste, sustainable agriculture, water harvesting, responsible consumption and systems that support mutual prosperity without damaging nature.
lq.QUESTION_DESC: Explain the importance of right utilisation of resources with reference to water, food and population issues.
